card.name: Warning wording in antibiotic infection text
card.fires_on: The word "considered" in the C. difficile warning "CDAD must be considered in all patients who present with diarrhea". It also fires on a few similar spots in infection warnings.

card.writes: It suppresses symptom words such as nausea, fatigue and feeling, so the next word is less likely to be a symptom.
card.plain: It marks warning sentences about antibiotic-related infections and makes a symptom word less likely to come next.
